main.description: laundryroom-specific details of a community.lexicon.calendar.event, authored by the group next to the event in the same calendar space. The rkey must equal the rkey of the event (a TID), so there is one per event.

capacity.description: Maximum number of attendees. Omitted when there is no limit; whether the event is full is derived, never stored. At most the number of places a social.laundryroom.calendar.attendance record can list.

organizer.description: DID of the member who organizes the meetup.

locationText.description: Where the meetup happens, as free text. Kept here when the event carries no structured location.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the record was created.
